black.$description: Volt Black — canvas color and primary foreground. All text, icons, and UI on light surfaces.

white.$description: Pure White — primary light surface. Base background for all light-mode screens.

200.$description: Inactive nav circle, dividers on light surfaces

300.$description: Interpolated — disabled text and decorative elements

500.$description: Brand board Mid Gray — secondary text. 3.9:1 on white; passes AA for large text only.

700.$description: Interpolated — dark-surface borders and secondary elements

800.$description: Brand board Charcoal — progress tracks, elevated dark surfaces

900.$description: Interpolated — raised dark surface (elevation model B)

950.$description: Brand board Volt Black alias in grey ramp

100.$description: Tint background — subtle success wash, hover state fill on light surfaces

300.$description: Hover / focus wash on interactive elements

500.$description: Electric Green — primary brand accent. Background only on light surfaces. Foreground must always be color.black. Against white: 1.36:1 (unusable as text). Against black: 15.4:1 (AAA).

600.$description: Pressed state on primary action elements

700.$description: Dark green — the only accessible green for text on white surfaces (4.6:1, passes WCAG AA)
